summary: The draft is internally coherent. The goal is to find the best per-collection configuration and structure, and the result is a set of per-collection winning profiles with per-question evidence. The repeated unit is one per-collection study, with one tuning-set trial as its sub-unit. Progress is coverage-weighted c = 0.5 + 0.25A + 0.25B, with A and B denominators fixed by addendum rev 4 and credit gated on verified result-bearing closures. The stopping rule makes the root terminal update the operative end. Root stagnation cannot fire early, because each counted closure adds at least 0.5/N, and the draft says target 1.0 may be unreachable. Capabilities are write_file, execute_code and todo_list, and all HTTP goes through the single allowlisted client. The deliverable is the extended manifest with a hashed root manifest referenced by the terminal update. Creator scope stays design-only, and the design_scope's addendum > ledger > execution_policy order settles the overlapping rules. Those rules cover holdout #3, close-out sizing, the blocked vocabulary, not_tested versus bound_hit on cuts, and the use_graph default. The draft never loosens safety_policy rev 2. The evidence requirement and acceptance source match the host facts. No material incoherence was found.
